FIX

EXTERNAL PROBES AND MUTATIONS

After clean recompilation against the parent case-class shapes, all three construction tests failed exactly as required: PropositionChart line 28, AmrGraph line 27, StoryModel line 23. Thus the probes kill reintroduction and do not pass vacuously.
